locator: Your Phone Can Wait and safe-driving tips, page lines 51-86
observations: Driving requires attention to the driving task; visual, manual and cognitive distraction can occur together.
A driver who needs to read or send a message should pull over to a safe place and park first.
A passenger can handle messages and notifications can be silenced before travel.
limitations: Legal references and crash statistics on the page are United States-specific and are not generalized to Turkey.
